declarations.name: Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.StructuralClauses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData k},
  ContinuousOn d.target d.params →
    (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun z => d.profile z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2) →
      (∀ (q : Fin k → ℝ), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profile q)) →
        (∀ q ∈ d.params, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (d.profile q σ) y = 0) →
          (∀ q ∈ d.params,
              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                ‖d.profile q σ y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ∧
                  ‖fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 ∧
                    ‖d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y‖ ≤ d.decay / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 3) →
            (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.profileSecondDeriv q z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profileSecondDeriv q)) →
                (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
                      Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (d.profile q σ) y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                        (d.profileSecondDeriv q σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                  (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                      ∀ γ ∈ d.symmetries,
                        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), d.profile q (σ + γ.2) (γ.1 y) = γ.1 (d.profile q σ y)) →
                    (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.pressureGrad q z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                      (∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.pressureGrad q)) →
                        (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                            ∀ (φ : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              Breakdown.IsSpaceTimeTestField φ →
                                ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (d.pressureGrad q z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2) = 0) →
                          (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,
                              ∀ q ∈ d.params,
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.adjoint j q z.1 z.2)
                                  MeasureTheory.volume) →
                            (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet, ∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.adjoint j q)) →
                              Breakdown.CellReduction.Instantiation.StructuralClauses d

            (∀ q ∈ d.params,
                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.profileSecondDeriv q z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ q ∈ d.params, Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (d.profileSecondDeriv q)) →

                        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), d.profile q (σ + γ.2) (γ.1 y) = γ.1 (d.profile q σ y)) →

                                ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (d.pressureGrad q z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2) = 0) →
                          (∀ j ∈ d.adjointSet,

                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => d.adjoint j q z.1 z.2)
                                  MeasureTheory.volume) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertReduction.weakFieldMollify
declarations.type:
∀ (w : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) (G : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
  (H : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space),
  Breakdown.IsWeakGradient w G →
    (∀ (j : Fin 3),
        Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
          (H y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
      ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖w y‖ ^ 6) < ⊤ →
        ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (Breakdown.matSq (G y)) < ⊤ →
          ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), ENNReal.ofReal (‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H y)‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
            ∃ u,
              (∀ (n : ℕ), ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (u n)) ∧
                (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (u n) 6 MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
                  (∀ (n : ℕ),
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.matSq (fderiv ℝ (u n) y)) MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
                    (∀ (n : ℕ),
                        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => ‖Breakdown.sumSecondPartialsAt (u n) y‖ ^ 2)
                          MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
                      (∀ (n : ℕ),
                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.matSq (fderiv ℝ (u n) y) ≤
                            ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.matSq (G y)) ∧
                        (∀ (n : ℕ),
                            ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖Breakdown.sumSecondPartialsAt (u n) y‖ ^ 2 ≤
                              ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖Breakdown.secondDerivTrace (H y)‖ ^ 2) ∧
                          ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => u n y) Filter.atTop (nhds (w y))

declarations.name: Breakdown.PotentialShape.polarFluxPart_weakDivergence
declarations.type:
∀ (P : Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.ShapeParams) (F : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotentialSeries),
  Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.IsShapeParams P →
    Breakdown.PotentialShape.IsPotentialSeries F →
      ∀ κ ∈ F.keys,
        ∀ (c : Breakdown.PotentialShape.PotComponent) (σ : ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin 3),
              MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable
                (fun y =>
                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.componentValue P κ (F.data κ).polarFlux c σ y *
                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.polarVecQ y i))
                MeasureTheory.volume) ∧
            (∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                ∀ (i : Fin 3),
                  DifferentiableAt ℝ
                    (fun x =>
                      Breakdown.PotentialShape.componentValue P κ (F.data κ).polarFlux c σ x *
                        ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.polarVecQ x i))
                    y) ∧
              MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable
                  (fun y =>
                    ∑ i,
                      (fderiv ℝ
                          (fun x =>
                            Breakdown.PotentialShape.componentValue P κ (F.data κ).polarFlux c σ x *
                              ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.polarVecQ x i))
                          y)
                        (Breakdown.unitVector i))
                  MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                ∀ (φ : Breakdown.Space → ℝ),
                  Breakdown.IsTestFunction φ →
                    ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                        ↑(φ y) *
                          ∑ i,
                            (fderiv ℝ
                                (fun x =>
                                  Breakdown.PotentialShape.componentValue P κ (F.data κ).polarFlux c σ x *
                                    ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.polarVecQ x i))
                                y)
                              (Breakdown.unitVector i) =
                      -∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          ∑ i,
                            ↑((fderiv ℝ φ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)) *
                              (Breakdown.PotentialShape.componentValue P κ (F.data κ).polarFlux c σ y *
                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.polarVecQ y i))

          S.Countable →
            ContinuousOn (fun ϑ => Real.sin ϑ ^ 2 • f (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a))
                (Set.Icc 0 Real.pi) →
              (∀ ϑ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 Real.pi \ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a)) →
                IntervalIntegrable

                          Breakdown.PotentialShape.Internal.PolarFlux.polarDiv f
                            (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a)))

                  IntervalIntegrable
                      (fun ϑ =>
                        (r ^ 2 * Real.sin ϑ) •
                          ∑ i,
                            ↑((fderiv ℝ φ (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a)) (Breakdown.unitVector i)) *
                              (f (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a) *
                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.polarVecQ
                                    (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a) i)))

                    ∫ (ϑ : ℝ) in 0..Real.pi,

                              (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a)) =
                      -∫ (ϑ : ℝ) in 0..Real.pi,
                          (r ^ 2 * Real.sin ϑ) •
                            ∑ i,

                                (f (Breakdown.PotentialShape.sphericalPoint r ϑ a) *

          (∀ (x : ℝ),
              |x| ≤ 1 →
                ∀ (t t' : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → 0 ≤ t' → t' ≤ 1 → ‖Φ t x - Φ t' x‖ ≤ Ct * max (1 - t) (1 - t') * |t - t'|) →
            (∀ (t : ℝ),
                0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → ∀ (x x' : ℝ), |x| ≤ 1 → |x'| ≤ 1 → ‖Φ t x - Φ t x'‖ ≤ Cx * (1 - t) ^ 2 * |x - x'|) →
              ∀ {z w : Breakdown.Space} {u r : ℝ},
                0 ≤ u →
                  0 < r →
                    1 - Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.chartCoord P z ≤ 2 * u →
                      1 - Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.chartCoord P w ≤ 2 * u →
                        r / 2 ≤ ‖w‖ →
                          ‖Φ (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.chartCoord P z)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.heightRatio z) -
                                Φ (Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.chartCoord P w)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.heightRatio w)‖ ≤
                            8 * Ct * (u ^ 3 / P.chartLength) * ‖z - w‖ + 16 * Cx * (u ^ 2 / r) * ‖z - w‖
